decisions.reason: The board size, aspect ratio, shape, and mounting-hole dimensions do not change the required NTC connection on J_BAT.
The mechanical-layout decision does not alter the battery-protection modes or cutoff values.
The mechanical-layout constraints do not change the battery NTC temperature-sensing method.
The board dimensions and mounting details do not change the boost converter's enable control, pull-down, or powered-load behavior.
The source decision does not change the requirement for TVS-based ESD protection.
Placing USB-C on the shorter edge is a mechanical-layout constraint and does not change the connector type, data-line capability, or sourceability requirements.
The power-board mechanical dimensions do not necessarily alter the specified interboard cable limit, I2C speed, pull-up resistance, or pull-up location.
The compact-board and mounting constraints do not modify the existing component availability and fallback-selection rules.
